title: Potato!craft
description: A mod turn every blocks you dig into baked potato
body:
WARNING:This is a very hard mod!If you aren't a top player of MC,please think some times while you install this mod.

**Potato!Craft**
_A Minecraft Fabric mod_ that makes all blocks drop baked potatoes when broken!

# Features
All blocks drop baked potatoes when broken
Maintains the original drop count (e.g., if a block normally drops 2 items, it will drop 2 baked potatoes)
Works with all blocks in the game
P.S:Please be mentally prepared before mining for diamonds, as you will only get a few baked potatoes.
